summary.text: Lindsey Daugherty, a Democrat, represents District 19 (Adams and Jefferson counties) in the Colorado State Senate.

paragraphs.text: She has held the seat since January 2025, after serving in the Colorado House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025.
She earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Northern Iowa in 2008 and a J.D. from the University of Denver in 2012.
Her career experience includes owning a law firm and working as a guardian ad litem for the State of Wyoming and as a prosecutor for the City of Douglas, Wyoming.
